# Prompt templates

A template supplies the domain wording of the system prompt. A codebook can override any of these strings in its `prompt:` block. Built-in templates are frozen: their wording never changes, so a run that records a template name can always be reproduced.

Use a template with `prompt_template: <name>` in a run config, or `--template <name>` with `cba render`, `cba validate` and `cba check-invariance`. You can also give the path of your own template YAML file with the same four keys.

## `default_v1`

| Key | Text |
|---|---|
| `role` | `You are an expert annotator tasked with analyzing text according to a codebook.` |
| `task` | `Your task is to predict the presence or absence of each of the following categories based on the provided coding rules.` |
| `rules_heading` | `### Coding Rules:` |
| `reasoning_example` | `The text expresses ...` |
